reader_question: What share of all household income goes to each fifth of households?
title: The highest-income fifth of households received 51.6 percent of all household income in 2025, and the lowest fifth received 3.0 percent.
measure_line: Share of all household income received by each fifth of households, ranked by income, United States, 2025.
notes: The top 5 percent of households, part of the highest fifth, received 23.1 percent of all household income.
The survey counts money income before taxes and leaves out noncash benefits such as food aid.
Margins of error, at 90 percent confidence, are 0.08 points or less, too small to draw at this scale.
alt: Bars show each fifth of households’ share of all household income in 2025 against a tick at 20 percent, its share of households. The lowest fifth received 3.0 percent, the second 8.5, the middle 14.4 and the fourth 22.6; the highest fifth received 51.6 percent, more than the other four together.

table.caption: Share of household income by fifth of households, 2025

chart_notes: Each bar is a fifth’s share of income; the tick across it marks the fifth’s share of households, 20 percent. The highest and lowest fifths, which the title names, are in ink, and the middle three fifths in gray.
